parts.problem_md:
A plane leaves Karachi at 1530 to fly to Bangkok. 
The distance is 3840 km.

The plane flies at an average speed of 720 km/h.
 The local time in Bangkok is 2 hours ahead of the local time in Karachi.

Find the local time in Bangkok when the plane arrives.
parts.solution_md:
> *The formula for speed is*

$\mathrm{speed}=\frac{\mathrm{distance}}{\mathrm{time}}$

> *Rearrange to make time the subject*

$\mathrm{time}=\frac{\mathrm{distance}}{\mathrm{speed}}$

> *Substitute in the values*

$\mathrm{time}=\frac{3840}{720}=5.333...$

**[1]**

> *Convert to hours and minutes.*

$5.333...\mathrm{hours}=5\mathrm{hours}20\mathrm{minutes}$

**[1]**

> *Add the time onto the start time.*

$15:30+5\mathrm{hours}20\mathrm{minutes}=20:50$

**[1]**

> *The time is 2 hours ahead so add on 2 hours.*

$20:50+2\mathrm{hours}=22:50$

**22:50** **[1]**

equations.alt: speed space equals fraction numerator space distance over denominator time end fraction
time space equals fraction numerator space distance over denominator speed end fraction
time space equals 3840 over 720 space equals space 5.333...
5.333... space hours space equals space 5 space hours space 20 space minutes
15 colon 30 space plus space 5 space hours space 20 space minutes space equals space 20 colon 50
20 colon 50 space plus space 2 space hours space equals space 22 colon 50
